question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Confused
solution:
The correct answer is** "Lucid."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Confused"** means not clear or muddled. (स्‍पष्‍ट रूप से सोच-विचार करने में असमर्थ; चकराया या उलझा हुआ, भ्रमित)

 
 
• **Example: ***She was **confused**__ and dazed.*
 
 
 
• **"Lucid"** means clear or easily understood. ((भाषण या लेखन) समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट और सरल, सुबोध)
 __
 
• **Example:** *She gave a clear and **lucid**__ account of her plans for the company's future.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of "**confused"** is **lucid**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Developed** means advanced or matured in growth.
 
• **Stupi**d means lacking intelligence or common sense.
 
• **Tangled** means twisted or knotted together.
